content: Standard offline-UX tiering by data age: <5min old = no indicator; 5-30min = small discrete 'Updated Xm ago' timestamp; 30min-24h = more visible timestamp/subtle amber accent; >24h = explicit warning color + 'Last updated yesterday' text. Prefer subtle persistent indicator (small icon/label) over intrusive banners; reserve a banner/status-bar indicator for fully-offline state to clarify all visible content is cached. Avoid alarming red banners for routine staleness.
